# Whole-graph integration

Stable IDs generation-lifecycle (mistral_qualification) and gated-delta-contract (vllm_cache_route) write actual bounded subtrees; main author owns root, provenance, source rights, cases, integrated checks and generated discovery/coverage. All material authors are actual gpt-6.1-sol at xhigh. Source/CPU-supported candidate delivery is adapted for unavailable native Swift toolchain, not a completed live API/package inspection or managed DisCo import.

Graph reconciliation keeps locks versus full-stream ownership, source cancellation order versus preemption, info versus task join, public branch predicate versus dispatch, FP32 state versus input dtype, and source mask asymmetry versus observed numerical bug distinct. Cases/reports remain outside runtime. Final independent review and current-head repository checks precede integration; no published GitHub APPROVE is assumed.
